material.locator: ILOSTAT Labour Force Statistics (LFS and RURBAN databases), Description — Overview; ILO Thesaurus, concept 13.01.1 “Labour economics”, Scope Notes; ILOSTAT Concepts and Definitions.
material.description: The ILOSTAT LFS description identifies labour-force statistics as a basis for monitoring the functioning of labour markets; the ILO Thesaurus defines labour economics as the aspects of economics concerned with labour supply and demand. Together these locators support the introductory scope of the claim. This is a concise conceptual definition, not an exhaustive account of the discipline or all labour-market institutions.
